method: Actual original THREE Vector2/Elf.update and ClientSystem methods in CPU VM; native production V::norm/Player stage and real finish_frame Client branch compared. Movement uses raw IEEE754 bit strings; timer uses independent supplied performance and game clocks. No browser, GPU/window, focus/input/audio or host execution.
changes: V::norm divides by length||1, preserving signed zero/subnormals and retaining non-NaN components when length is NaN.
Elf movement compares source-computed normalized vector length, not configured step. Squared/sum/sqrt and multiplication order retained; no epsilon/Math.hypot substitution.
Client death stores and compares wall/performance namespace, retaining strict >2500ms, immediate gone path, zero sentinel and original no-reset-on-revive behavior.
